name: contrastapi
description: Security intelligence MCP server for AI agents. CVE lookup with EPSS/KEV enrichment, composite risk scoring (CVSS+EPSS+KEV+PoC fusion) and CVSS v3.x vector parsing, domain reconnaissance (DNS, WHOIS, SSL, subdomains, WAF detection), IOC/threat intel, email/phone/username OSINT, code security checks, MITRE ATLAS (AI/ML attack catalog) with bulk technique drill, MITRE D3FEND (defense techniques mapped to ATT&CK), and web intelligence (robots.txt parser, redirect-chain walker, email validation, brand-asset scraper, SEO audit). 53 tools, no API key required.
